description: Polish is the fallback donor for en, ru, ar, fr and pt requests. Polish is the sharpest donor against Russian: verified against GeneratedCldrPluralData, the two rule sets agree at every integer except where i%10 = 1 and i != 1 and i%100 != 11 (21, 31, ..., 101, 1001), where pl says MANY and ru says ONE. Six loaded locales, six distinct primary language codes, so tiebreakers are null.
